entities.name: 智能体 (agent)
entities.how_described: 本集既是产品核心(优化坏打断、避免智能体介入太早),又讲了内部如何管理一支智能体舰队——实现、审查、PR 牧羊人、分诊机器人,管理智能体像管理人

evidence.quote: And the deeper lesson was to stop optimizing for fewer interruptions and start optimizing for fewer bad ones where the agent would jump in way too early.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And the biggest lesson in building that system is that an agent's context comes mostly from the code base itself, not so much from the Cloud MD file.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And we also have a triage bot that fires on every inbound bug report that we get, and they're all wired through MCP into linear, into Sentry, Datadog, so an agent can reconstruct a crash and route it itself and oftentimes open the PR on its own and just fix the bug.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We have iOS and backend product engineering roles, applied AI engineering, gameplay engineering, and one specific role I want to flag, which is agent engineering management.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 延迟 (latency)
entities.how_described: 本集反复强调延迟就是产品:语音往返必须在两秒内,漂移到两秒半几乎让所有指标崩了,要按管线逐阶段分开测量

evidence.quote: Early on, our latency drifted from two seconds to about two and a half seconds, and that half second tanked basically every metric in the product.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And we happily paid about 60 milliseconds of extra latency to do it.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Latency isn't just a number you check at the end, it's actually the product, and we measure every stage of the pipeline separately because it feels slow is useless.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 记忆 (memory)
entities.how_described: 本集说让陪伴体像陪伴的关键是记忆:当检索系统做,提取事实/偏好/情绪信号向量化存储,每晚压缩,分成稳定与不稳定两部分

evidence.quote: So instead, we see memory as a sort of retrieval system.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So, and we also split memory into two parts.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We have stable memory and unstable memory.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 上下文 (context)
entities.how_described: 本集主张易变的语音对话里每轮从零件重建上下文窗口(摘要、画像卡、检索记忆、语气指引、应用状态),不要为保缓存热度跨轮复用;智能体的上下文主要来自代码库本身

evidence.quote: So the core difference really is that in a text chatbot, turns are relatively slow and context is stable.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And the context is volatile.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: It leads to the model getting lost in the middle of a huge context and also hallucinating.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The last principle is around context.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Specifically, you should rebuild context and not fight drift.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So most apps reuse context across turns to keep the cache warm.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: But in a volatile voice conversation, it's a trap because the second the user pivots, your reuse context is actively wrong.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So every turn, we reassemble the context window from parts.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And the biggest lesson in building that system is that an agent's context comes mostly from the code base itself, not so much from the Cloud MD file.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: LLM
entities.how_described: 本集说几乎所有 LLM 应用都建立在文字聊天「轮次慢、上下文稳定」的假设上,而语音打破了这一假设

evidence.quote: And almost every LLM app assumes that.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Most LLM apps assume that you'll have a clean and stable conversation, and we had to build for the opposite.
